# Ayaan Shahbaz — AI Automation Engineer & Full-Stack Developer

> Ayaan Shahbaz is an AI Automation Engineer and Full-Stack Developer specializing in autonomous AI agents, production n8n workflow automation, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, Python/Django REST architectures, and Next.js applications. Based in Pakistan and collaborating with international founders, startups, and remote teams worldwide.

## Primary Roles & Professional Titles
- AI Automation Engineer
- Full-Stack Developer (Python, Django, Next.js, TypeScript)
- AI Systems & Autonomous Agent Developer
- n8n Automation Specialist
- RAG & LLM Integration Engineer

## Core Capabilities & Technical Arsenal
- **Agentic AI & LLMs:** Autonomous Multi-Agent Systems, Tool-Calling Agents, Model Context Protocol (MCP), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Vector Embeddings (ChromaDB, Pinecone, pgvector), Context Engineering, Guardrails, OpenAI API, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, OpenRouter.
- **Workflow Automation:** n8n (Self-hosted & Cloud), Webhook Orchestration, WhatsApp Cloud API, CRM Integrations (HubSpot, Airtable, Notion), Voice Agents (Vapi, ElevenLabs, Twilio), Lead Capture & Outreach Pipelines.
- **Backend Architecture:** Python, Django, Django REST Framework (DRF), PostgreSQL, Redis, Celery, JWT Authentication, Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), BOLA-Defended API Gateways.
- **Frontend & SaaS:** Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Interactive Dashboards, Real-Time Streaming UI.

## Featured Production Systems
- **OrvinHQ:** Multi-tenant enterprise workplace and HR operations platform built with Python Django and Next.js, featuring stateless JWT rotation, cross-tenant BOLA isolation, and real-time team coordination.
- **AURA AI:** RAG-powered business knowledge assistant with Model Context Protocol (MCP) and n8n orchestration for autonomous context injection, appointment scheduling, and lead qualification.
- **Convoo AI:** Streaming conversational AI web platform featuring persistent user memory, tool integrations, and real-time response streaming.
- **Autonomous Content Intelligence System:** Multi-agent pipeline researching industry trends, generating synthesized media assets, and executing publication workflows without human intervention.
- **AI Voice & WhatsApp Dental Receptionist:** 24/7 conversational receptionist powered by Vapi, LLMs, and n8n handling patient inquiries, qualifying procedures, and booking slots directly into clinic calendars.
